page.layout: One printed page, a title page centred on the scan: all lines in the centre, no running head, no page number. The Google digitiser watermark at lower right is not transcribed.
page.notes: The title is set in mixed type: the first lines and MINERVAL in capitals with letter spacing, RESPONSIO and the last line in italic. The word "RE.SPONSIO," has a printed stop after E. Some lines use long-s forms in italic ("secunda", "comprehensa" with a terminal s-like form), transcribed here as plain s. The watermark "Digitized by Google" is excluded as a digitiser's mark.
